ja.subtitle: 研究室・チームのためのセルフホスト型チャット
ja.promotionalText: 研究室やチームが自分たちのサーバーで運用するチャット。チャンネルとスレッド、日本語と英語の全文検索、投票・予定・タスク、確実なプッシュ通知で、毎日の連絡をひとつにまとめます。
ja.keywords: チャット,チーム,研究室,ゼミ,セルフホスト,社内チャット,メッセージ,スレッド,グループ,連絡,通知,検索,投票,予定,タスク,スタンプ
ja.description:
Taylis(テイリス)は、研究室やゼミ、小さなチームのためのチャットアプリです。メッセージは自分たちで用意したサーバーに保存されるので、会話の記録を手元で管理できます。

※ 使うには、所属する組織の Taylis サーバーと、管理者が発行したアカウントが必要です。アプリから新しく登録することはできません。

【主な機能】
・チャンネル(公開・非公開)、DM、グループ DM
・スレッドでの返信、メンション、リアクション
・「確認しました」などの文字のリアクションや、スタンプ
・日本語と英語の全文検索(送信者・チャンネル・期間で絞り込み)
・写真・動画・ファイルの共有
・投票、日程調整、予定、タスク
・共有の機材やアカウントの順番待ち(予約)
・プッシュ通知(チャンネルごとの設定、通知しない時間帯)
・スマートフォン・パソコン・ブラウザで未読の位置を同期
・複数のサーバーの切り替え

【安全のために】
・不適切なメッセージの報告、ユーザーのブロック
・アプリからのアカウント削除
・2 要素認証。組織が許可した場合は、組織の Google アカウントでもログインできます

サーバーの管理者が有効にした場合だけ、AI による要約や質問への回答も使えます。このとき、会話の内容は管理者が選んだ AI サービスに送られます。

プライバシーポリシー: https://kano.ac/pages/apps/taylis-privacy-policy/

en-US.name: Taylis - Team Chat for Labs
en-US.subtitle: Self-hosted chat for teams
en-US.promotionalText: Team chat that your lab or organization runs on its own server: channels, threads, Japanese and English search, polls, events and reliable push notifications.
en-US.description:
Taylis is a channel-based chat app for labs, seminars and small teams that run their own Taylis server. Messages are stored only on the server your organization operates; nothing is sent to the developer or to advertisers.

Note: you need an account on a Taylis server run by your organization. Accounts are created by the server administrator; there is no public sign-up.

- Public and private channels, direct and group messages
- Threads, mentions, reactions (emoji, text reactions and your organization's stickers)
- Polls, scheduling, channel events and tasks, and a queue for shared equipment
- Full-text search in Japanese and English, filtered by person, channel and date
- Push notifications with per-channel settings and quiet hours; the app always resyncs with the server
- Photo, video and file attachments
- Report messages, block users, delete your own messages and delete your account in the app
- Two-factor authentication, and sign-in with your organization's Google account when the server allows it
- Switch between several servers

Optional AI features (a bot and summaries) are available only when your server administrator enables them; conversation content is then sent to the AI provider the administrator chose.

review.notes:
Taylis is a chat client for self-hosted Taylis servers. Each organization (for example a university research lab) runs its own server and its administrator creates the accounts. There is no public sign-up and the app is not a general social network: people only talk with members of their own organization.

How to sign in for review:
1. On the first screen, enter the server URL: {server_url}
2. Username: {demo_user}   Password: see the Sign-In Information above.
3. Tap "ログイン" (Log in).

The review account is a member of the channel #sample only (it cannot see the organization's other channels). You can post messages, reply in threads, add reactions and create a poll there.

Sign in with Google: on servers that enable it, the button reads "g.ibaraki.ac.jp のアカウントでログイン" ("Log in with your g.ibaraki.ac.jp account", with a building icon). It accepts only accounts of the organization's own Google Workspace domain configured on that server (an existing education/enterprise account). The app has no other third-party or social login, so we believe Sign in with Apple is not required (Guideline 4.8, education/enterprise account exception). The review server uses a username and password.

User-generated content safeguards (Guideline 1.2):
- Report: long-press a message and choose "報告する" (Report). Reports go to the server administrators, who can delete messages and deactivate accounts.
- Block: open a person's profile and choose "ブロック" (Block); their messages are hidden.
- Users can edit and delete their own messages.
- Only members created or invited by the organization's administrator can post.
- Contact: kanotown@gmail.com

Account deletion (Guideline 5.1.1(v)): 自分 (You) tab > アカウント (Account) > アカウントを削除 (Delete account). The profile and sign-in data are erased and the user's messages remain as "退会したユーザー" (deleted user).

Push notifications: the app asks for permission after sign-in. To check delivery, open 自分 (You) > 通知 (Notifications) and tap "テスト通知を送る" (Send test notification).

Networking: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads is set because each organization enters its own server URL, and servers on a local network may not have TLS. Production servers use HTTPS.

Optional AI features (summaries, a bot) are server-side and only appear when the server administrator enables them; they are optional and not needed for the review.
